description: A Svelte 5 data grid whose gallery cards draw each field the way its cell does: single and multiple select pills in their colors, rating stars, a person with an avatar and a currency amount, with each field type's icon beside its name. The cover is the first image of an attachment field.
keywords: svelte gallery view with select pills
svelte data grid rating stars cards

faq.question: Why do the cards show pills and stars instead of text?
faq.answer: The columns are declared by field type (@svgrid/enterprise/fields). A card draws a field-typed value with the same cell the table uses, so a single select is a colored pill and a rating is stars.

faq.question: Can the cover come from an attachment field?
faq.answer: Yes. When the cover field holds a list of files, the gallery uses the first image in it, at its thumbnail URL when it has one.

faq.question: Which modules does this need?
faq.answer: enableGalleryView() from @svgrid/enterprise for the cards, and enableFields() from @svgrid/enterprise/fields for the field types. The grid is the MIT @svgrid/grid package.
